# lab-steps

Folds every floe's plan steps into one set, expanding the cluster conditions.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

## Emits

| alias | kind | what it carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| labSteps | catallaxy.labSteps | Every plan step the lab's floes contribute, keyed by step name. |

## What it emits

Rendered by `gitops.local` as the lab unit `steps`. A unit of the lab
installs nothing into a cluster, and its provisions are sealed inside the
lab's inclusion — so its declaration above is its interface.

## Output kinds

| kind | entries |
| --- | --- |
| catallaxy.labSteps | apply-root-application, bootstrap-argocd, bootstrap-repos, cert-generate, docker-network-create, publish-manifests, registry-setup, remove-network, warm-cache |
